title: Paolo Trivellato three-part LinkedIn lead-magnet viral recipe
summary: Starborn founder Paolo Trivellato breaks LinkedIn lead-magnet virality into thumbnail image, specific hook, and comment-gated body—claiming 20k+ client comments in 30 days with no in-post links and one-word CTAs under six letters.
question_it_answers: How does Paolo Trivellato structure LinkedIn lead magnets to maximize comment engagement?

claims.text: Lead magnets need a YouTube-thumbnail-style image with proof screenshots because weak images cause most underperformance.
claims.evidence: Treat this like a YouTube thumbnail. One big visual idea, a clear proof point, strong contrast
claims.subject: outbound-gtm-agents

claims.text: Hooks should pair a specific numeric result with an unanswered question, e.g. 672 demos in 30 days on LinkedIn.
claims.evidence: "I booked 672 demos in 30 days using LinkedIn" will always beat "how to get more leads on LinkedIn."
claims.subject: outbound-gtm-agents

claims.text: Distribution uses a one-word CTA under six letters with the link only in comments, never the post body.
claims.evidence:
Keep the CTA to one word under 6 letters
> Never put a link in the post body, the comment is the distribution mechanism
claims.subject: outbound-gtm-agents

media.description: Wide LinkedIn engagement screenshot showing 3,152 reactions, 12,341 comments, 36 reposts, and 1.4M impressions as social proof.

judge_hints.why_must_read: Research ties 672-demo hook to Starborn case study and longer LinkedIn playbook.
